issues.title: Standard PING frame is not secure
issues.author: kwatsen
issues.body:
# Issue

Standard PING frame is like an ICMP Echo Request (network ping) or a TCP Keep-Alive. It operates purely at the transport layer to see if the pipe is open.


# Possible solution

The Safe Extension Frame (PING_REQUEST)A cleaner, non-destructive extension would register a new frame type via transport parameters.Negotiation: During the handshake, both peers send a support_ping_request transport parameter.Mechanism: The server sends a new frame PING_REQUEST (0x44). The client is obligated by the extension spec to reply with a PING_REPLY (0x45).
